text: Mono- [Gr. monoV , single, only]: Ger. Mono -; Fr. mono -; Ital. mono- . (1) In one respect: as MONOMANIA (q.v.; also termed, by Clouston, monopsychosis). (2) Affecting one part or member of the body: as monoplegia, paralysis of one limb; monocular, relating to one eye; monologue, repetition of one sound (Lall-Monologe, Preyer: see LALLING). ( J.J. )
